Aspera Connect companion — install on phone
===========================================

Version: 0.3.3 (Hang up from PC + contacts)

1) Download AsperaConnect-0.3.3.apk from this folder / GitHub branch.
2) On phone: enable Install unknown apps for your browser/Files.
3) Open the APK → Install → Open Aspera Connect.
4) Allow: Phone, Answer phone calls, Contacts, Notifications.
5) Tap Start for calls — note the IP.
6) On PC: Connect for phone calls, then Call / Hang up from Contacts.

adb (optional):
  adb install -r AsperaConnect-0.3.3.apk
